title: Corrections at Universal Consciousness
excerpt: How to report an error in Universal Consciousness, and how the publication records a substantive fix.

quick_answer.question: How do corrections work?
quick_answer.answer: Email the page URL, the sentence you believe is wrong, and a source if you have one. If the desk confirms an error, it updates the page and the modified date.

intro:
Reference writing fails when an error stays invisible. Universal Consciousness corrects pages in public and keeps the correction attached to the page that changed.

This page explains how to send a report and what a reader should expect afterward. There is no separate list of corrections yet, because the publication is at its first release.

sections.heading: What should a report include?
sections.content:
Write to the address on the [contact](/contact/) page. Include the full URL, the passage, and why you think it is wrong. A link to a primary text, a university reference, or a government health page is the most useful attachment.

A disagreement with a tradition's theology is not, by itself, a correction. The page's job is often to describe a view it does not share. A correction is for a false citation, a mixed-up date, a misnamed school, or a health claim that outruns its source.

sections.heading: What happens after a report?
sections.content:
The desk reads the note and checks the cited source against the [editorial policy](/editorial-policy/). If the page is wrong, the sentence is rewritten. The modified date changes. A short note can be added on this page when the error would have misled a reader about a health or historical claim.

Typos may be fixed without a public log. Invented updates, meaning date changes with no real edit, are not part of the process. The page you are reading will stay short until there is a real correction to record.

key_takeaways: Send the URL, the sentence, and a source.
Confirmed factual errors are fixed on the page.
Modified dates track real changes only.

faq.question: Can I correct a definition I simply dislike?
faq.answer: You can write. The desk will change the page when the criticism shows an inaccuracy, not when it asks the publication to take sides in a doctrine.

faq.question: Are corrections deleted from the page history?
faq.answer: The live page shows the corrected text. Substantive health or history fixes can also be noted on this page.
